mission_phase: Generation 31 - WooCommerce parity: health rollup, findings, executive report, fix plan
phase_goal: Bring a WooCommerce store to feature parity with a Shopify site in the dashboard: derive a Health summary (readiness/coverage/status from the discovery surfaces), a Findings list (Critical/High/Medium/Low, store_finding vs capture_limitation), an executive-ready report (Markdown + JSON), and fix-plan items (from store findings). Surface all of it in the Woo site view like the Shopify view. Rendered (Playwright) capture remains the only flagged gap.
reason_generation_started: Operator: finish any missing implementation of Woo in comparison with Shopify. Industry West (WooCommerce, 246 SKUs / 148 browse nodes / 52 filterable facets) is the working target. Builds on GEN-028/029/030 (catalog, search, autocomplete, facets, discovery surfaces).
standing_directive: Operator authorized inspecting these Woo stores this session. Derive health/findings/report/fix-plan from captured evidence only; be honest (Recommendations is a capture limitation, not a store finding; report never over-claims). Do not fabricate data. Do not apply destructive cleanup.

functional: The capture derives and stores a health rollup (coverage %, readiness, status, surface pass/warn/limited counts), a findings list with severities and nature, an executive report (Markdown + JSON), and fix-plan items from store findings.
The Woo site view shows a Health summary panel, a Findings panel, an executive-report link, and a fix-plan panel - matching the Shopify site view's deliverables (minus rendered capture).

Findings and severities are derived from the surfaces (e.g. Search intent gap -> High; flat Browse -> Medium; Recommendations -> capture limitation), and the executive report reflects the real numbers for the target.
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user): open Industry West (and Legion), see Health + Findings + executive report + fix plan alongside catalog/search/autocomplete/facets; Shopify sites unaffected.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the Woo catalog endpoint returns health + findings, the report artifact exists/serves, and the Woo site view wires the Health/Findings/report/fix-plan panels; validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean.

validation_notes: VAL-080: Industry West parity view (Health bounded/60%, Findings HIGH Search/INFO Recommendations/MEDIUM Browse, Fix plan 2 items, executive report served) + Legion parity; Shopify unaffected; no run triggered.
Two clean gate passes; BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-020 (84 BDDs, 3 new for GEN-031, 82 passing, 2 deferred).
known_gaps_opened: Rendered (Playwright) capture for Woo is the sole remaining parity gap vs Shopify (Recommendations + faceted UI as customers see it); Cloudflare bot-challenge risk on these targets.
The care_instructions attribute inflates term counts with free-text values; a future refinement could distinguish true facets from free-text attributes.
